dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Is there a box around here I could borrow? You know, big square box, with that fresh cardboard smell...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I just thought I might take a quick nap, since we're not busy right now... is that alright?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I promise I'll take great care of it! Just like I take care of every parcel I ever deliver.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Are you thinking up ways to beat up those monsters? 'Cause I have a suggestion for you!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: You just need to sneak up behind them, lay low, wait till they're not looking... and then POUNCE!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't like it? But it works on even the sneakiest squirrels, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Compared to turning the pages myself and hearing that rustling sound, I prefer it when someone reads the story to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I like to lie down on someone's warm, soft lap, close my eyes, curl up, and lose myself in the story...
